source_conflicts_and_limits: Canva's official upload help describes imported PDF pages as images, whereas marketing describes editable PDF content. Import fidelity and design-type behaviour require an actual representative workflow.
Photo-editor marketing says some SVG exports are free while download help groups SVG/advanced export controls with eligible paid plans. Preserve the discrepancy rather than guess entitlement.
Some current help still names Canva Teams; pricing now presents Free, Pro, Business and Enterprise. Feature-specific help remains the source for explicit entitlements.
Published numerical storage, page and AI limits are service limits, not evidence that local reconstruction has reached equivalent scale.
The retained 24-script analysis is complete only within its public-homepage origin scope; it does not identify editor document formats or collaboration protocols.
verification_rules: A control or static menu is insufficient: execute its workflow and inspect durable output.
Only call a feature complete after appropriate Linux and macOS build/runtime evidence.
Local state or tab coordination does not prove network collaboration or account-sync parity.
Deterministic hints do not prove AI model, ATS score, economy or original-algorithm parity.
Do not publish captured proprietary assets, raw site DOM, scripts, account data or request logs.
tier_scope: Legacy Teams where help explicitly retains it
Education/Higher Education/Nonprofits where named by feature help
tier_notes: Paid workflow scope includes licensed premium media, resize, background tools, brand templates/components, scheduling, bulk creation, organisation controls and integrations.
The independent OSS implementation may expose these workflows freely; reproducing source paywalls is not an acceptance requirement.
The current pricing comparison says Free template customisation is unavailable, while official free-template/editor pages describe customisation. Preserve the contradiction.
Enterprise AI 2.0/connectors are marked soon on pricing; a future-listed capability must not be represented as universally available today.
Current pricing and upload help disagree on some Enterprise storage bounds; tiers and exact limits require account-level verification.

non_software_offerings.offering: Physical print fulfilment and plan-specific print discount
non_software_offerings.prerequisite: Manufacturing/shipping provider and authorised order workflow; exporting a print PDF is a narrower capability.

non_software_offerings.offering: Support, dedicated success and professional services
non_software_offerings.prerequisite: Staffed operations and contracted support delivery; these are not editor controls.
Separate application/platform scope and licence entitlement; Stencil Studio does not establish Affinity parity.

criteria_basis: Acceptance criteria and prerequisites are independently designed engineering requirements, not observed original-service tests or recovered implementation.
